responses.text: Leave me alone. Can't you see a man's fighting for his life here?
What is it? Can't you see I want to be left alone with my friend here?
Tell the King we thank him for looking out for us.
Oh. That's different then. How can I help? I'll do anything to get the bastards that did this.

topics.prompt: The King asked me to look into your attack.

responses.text: Well, it happened at night. Around eleven. We had recently made some caps off a bit of scrap we found, and wanted to invest it wisely.
As we were leaving the Wrangler, we must've taken a wrong turn, and ended up in the Squatter side of town.
From out of nowhere, these big guys show up and start barking questions at us. Wanted to know if we were locals.
The kid there's about as proud as a local around here gets, and started yelling back at them. Then all hell broke loose.
Kid got the worst of it, sad to say.

topics.prompt: What can you tell me about the attack?

responses.text: They were big guys. Young, too. No old geezers like me. Hell, none of them looked even half my age.
I was mostly face down in the dirt, begging for my life when it happened, so I only got a quick look at them.

topics.prompt: Do you remember anything about the people who attacked you?

responses.text: You were just curious. No harm in that. I'm just worried sick about my friend here.
I hope you find the bastards that did this. If you want, try asking my friend Wayne over there about them. He saw more than I did.
Yeah, the docs say he's going to be laid up for a while, assuming he doesn't get any worse.

topics.prompt: Your friend looks like he's in bad shape.

responses.text: Wayne, it's okay. The King sent 'em.
The boy means well, but he's dumb as a mutant sometimes.
